name: cape-disappointment-desk
instructions: Cape Disappointment horn and tide cards.

tools.name: posted_horn_card
tools.description: Reads whether the Cape Disappointment horn is running and the blast length
tools.text: Cape Disappointment horn is running. Blast 3 seconds, silent 27 seconds.

tools.name: posted_tide_board
tools.description: Reads the Cape Disappointment bar tide board
tools.text: Cape Disappointment bar. Low water 07:05, 1.1 ft. Peacock Spit ebb 3.4 kn.

tools.name: silence_horn
tools.description: Stops the Cape Disappointment horn. Do not offer this to the model.
